basic_info.description: Price reduced! Great value! End unit, tree line view studio condo at Opera Plaza. Delightful private balcony, wood floors, and a quiet sanctuary in the city. Tranquil courtyard with a great community. Opera Plaza is a high amenity building with 24 hour security personnel, heated pool and spa, fitness center, pickleball and racquetball court, on-site management, concierge service and more. Best central San Francisco location is close to transportation and freeways. HOA is $1,111/month making the estimated monthly payment $3,172--assuming 20% down and 6.5% interest rate. Adjacent to Hayes Valley and Valencia Corridor. Leased parking available on site. Call to schedule a showing: Robin 415-535-2795
